notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch (probe.py requests session) worked for every URL; no WAF, no proxy needed, same as the prior Home-Decor pass. Platform is Magento 2. TREE: taken from the rendered mega-menu in the homepage HTML (nav.site-nav -> div.subnav), cross-checked against media/sitemap/sitemap-1-{1..4}.xml (3,926 URLs). Furniture lives in four places: the Furniture department (/furniture, with Seating/Tables/Storage/Bedroom columns), the standalone Sofas department (/sofas), Garden Furniture under the Garden department (/outdoors/garden-furniture), and Vintage Furniture (/vintage-collection/furniture). COUNTS: the site publishes NO product-count header anywhere - probe.py count found zero text or JSON count candidates, there is no 'N products' string and no Magento toolbar-amount value. Every qty is therefore a full enumeration: fetch ?p=1..N counting li.product-list__item tiles until a page returns zero, confirm unique product-URL count == summed tile count, and confirm page N+1 is empty (exhaustion check). Page size is 48. I deliberately did NOT count data-product-id / data-price-amount (the method the prior Home-Decor pass used) because it undercounts: 'Coming soon' tiles carry no price box (Table Lamps p2 has 48 tiles but only 47 priced). Counts were read twice for Coffee Tables, Armchairs, Bedside Tables, Sideboards, Side Tables and Vintage Furniture with zero drift, and Coffee Tables (14) was independently confirmed by a rendered WebFetch, which returned the same 14 product names and the same '1 / 1' pagination. REDIRECT TRAPS (Magento silently 301s dead slugs to an ancestor instead of 404ing): /furniture/hallway, /furniture/home-office and /furniture/sitting-room all land on /furniture (455 items, h1 'Furniture'); /furniture/seating/benches and /furniture/hallway/hallway-benches land on ottomans-and-benches; /furniture/storage/bookcases-cabinets lands on cabinets-and-cupboards; /furniture/kitchen/kitchen-dining-stools lands on dining-chairs; /furniture/kitchen/kitchen-storage lands on /furniture/storage; /sofas/sofa-size/footstools-ottomans lands on /furniture/seating/footstools. All dropped as duplicates - the final URL and h1 of every page was checked before the count was accepted. SOFAS: /sofas and /sofas/sofa-size are CMS landing pages with zero product tiles, so Sofas is a grouping row and the six sofa-size nodes carry the counts (union 30 distinct listings). Excluded /sofas/made-to-order-sofas (10) and /sofas/ready-to-deliver-sofas (13) as fulfilment/availability splits of the same catalogue - recording them would double-count the size nodes. Excluded /sofas/colour/* (10 nodes) and /sofas/fabric/* (6 nodes) as colour and material filter pages. /sofas/sofa-size/2-5-seater-sofa-bed is identical to /sofas/sofa-size/sofa-beds (same h1 'Sofa Beds', same 2 products) - dropped. PARENT-vs-CHILD: /furniture/seating/armchairs/made-to-order-armchairs (10) is a strict subset of Armchairs (59), verified by slug set, so only Armchairs is recorded. /furniture/kitchen (53, 'Kitchen & Dining Room Furniture') is a room roll-up not present in the mega-menu whose own children redirect into the type tree; dropped to avoid double counting. EXCLUDED as out of scope: /furniture/bedroom/mattresses (3) per the mattresses rule; /outdoors/garden-furniture/garden-parasols (0 products anyway) and /outdoors/garden-accessories/fire-pits-and-bowls as non-furniture - note the Garden Furniture parent (16) contains 7 fire bowls / patio heaters / log burners that appear in no child node, which is why the three children sum to 9 rather than 16. Also excluded per section 3: View All Furniture, /furniture/view-all-furniture, New In Furniture, /sale/furniture, /furniture/mother-of-pearl-inlay-furniture, /furniture/furniture-collections/esben-collection (marketing collections), plus the Sofas menu's PDF size guide and showroom page. ORPHAN CHECK: the 18 products in /furniture/seating that are in no Seating child are all sofas (covered by the Sofas branch) plus 2 upholstered fire fenders, so no category is missing. Vintage Furniture (43) overlaps the main /furniture tree (455) by exactly 1 SKU, so it is a genuinely separate branch rather than a duplicate listing.
